'''Curamelle''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. It was home to the [[Corulag Academy]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military academy.<ref name="CatCW" /> A wing of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] was based here to protect the [[Sienar Advanced Research Division]], just north of the city. Also, after the city's liberation from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], the former governor of the planet was hung in the city square.
